title: Make a price list with VAT and a trade discount the shop can change
person: A shop owner selling garden tools who wants prices with and without VAT for trade customers.
review: Each of the five tools shows its price excluding VAT, the 10 percent trade price and the price including 25 percent VAT; the VAT rate and the discount are inputs.
revised_review: With the trade discount at 15 percent every trade price follows; nothing else changes.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
No hidden rows, columns or sheets.
Every column of the table has one unique heading.
Every value in a column of numbers is stored as a number.
The VAT rate and the discount sit in their own labelled cells; no formula types 1.25 or 0.9 in.
The spade reads 349, 314.10 trade and 436.25 including VAT; the other four follow the same way.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the people, clubs, shops and numbers are invented.
